column3: 1. Make your keys: the private halves never leave this machine
python3 /opt/k8s-lan-party/visit.py keygen /root/mykeys --nebula-cert /opt/nebula/nebula-cert
keys: /root/mykeys (host.key and seal.key never leave this machine; host.pub and seal.pub go to the page)
2. Ask for a place: solve the page's puzzle, get a claim code
python3 /opt/k8s-lan-party/visit.py request https://<ip> visitor --keys /root/mykeys --cacert /opt/k8s-lan-party/page-ca.crt --nebula-cert /opt/nebula/nebula-cert
asked as visitor (proof of work: 0.5 s). Claim code: <claim-code> (saved in /root/mykeys/claim-code)
3. Wait in the list: the only place is taken
python3 /opt/k8s-lan-party/visit.py status https://<ip> --keys /root/mykeys --cacert /opt/k8s-lan-party/page-ca.crt --nebula-cert /opt/nebula/nebula-cert
visitor: in the list, position 1 of 1; estimated around 2026-11-04T05:31:41Z
python3 /opt/k8s-lan-party/visit.py wait https://<ip> --keys /root/mykeys --cacert /opt/k8s-lan-party/page-ca.crt --nebula-cert /opt/nebula/nebula-cert --interval 10
4. Keep visit.py wait running: it collects the sealed bundle the moment the place is yours
visitor: in the list, position 1 of 1; estimated around 2026-11-04T05:31:41Z
visitor: your place is ready: collect the bundle now (claim), its join token dies 8 minutes after approval
bundle: /root/mykeys/visitor (lease until 05:42:42 UTC)
join: sudo edge-mesh join /root/mykeys/visitor --accept-golden-rule
5. Join: one command, and your machine is a node of the cluster
edge-mesh join /root/mykeys/visitor --accept-golden-rule </dev/null
Golden rule: what runs on someone else's machine can be seen by its owner.
joined: visitor (trust=public)
your namespace: play-visitor; try: sudo edge-mesh kubectl get pods
6. Play: a pod in your own namespace (and the cluster says no to the rest)
edge-mesh kubectl apply -f /root/hello.json
pod/hello created
edge-mesh kubectl wait --for=condition=Ready pod/hello --timeout=180s
pod/hello condition met
edge-mesh kubectl get pods -o wide
NAME    READY   STATUS    RESTARTS   AGE   IP          NODE      NOMINATED NODE   READINESS GATES
hello   1/1     Running   0          7s    10.42.1.3   visitor   <none>           <none>
edge-mesh kubectl logs hello
hello from hello on the mesh
edge-mesh kubectl get nodes
Error from server (Forbidden): nodes is forbidden: User "system:serviceaccount:play-visitor:user" cannot list resource "nodes" in API group "" at the cluster scope
edge-mesh: forbidden (403): you may only work in your namespace play-visitor
7. Game over: the lease ended, the node is out
python3 /opt/k8s-lan-party/visit.py status https://<ip> --keys /root/mykeys --cacert /opt/k8s-lan-party/page-ca.crt --nebula-cert /opt/nebula/nebula-cert
visitor: your lease ended
edge-mesh kubectl get pods --request-timeout=10s
Unable to connect to the server: context deadline exceeded
